description: An end-to-end web engineering copilot with a rebuilt product-specific design engine, implementation, accessibility, testing, browser QA, visual regression, performance, security, and evidence-based release verification.

defaultPrompt: Redesign this interface from its actual product context; avoid generic AI templates and prove the composition is product-specific.
Diagnose why this design feels generic and rebuild its hierarchy and layout rather than changing only its colors.
Turn this website requirement into an implementation-ready product model, distinctive composition, and design system.
Run the Web Forge release gate and report evidence, failures, and unverified areas.
interface.longDescription: A product-aware web design and engineering workflow. Its rebuilt design engine models users, tasks, domain content, environment, brand, and technical constraints before generating distinct structural concepts; it then defines a project-specific visual grammar, implements it, and verifies the rendered result. Includes accessibility, testing, visual regression, browser QA, performance, security, and evidence-based release gates.
interface.shortDescription: Design with product context. Build and verify.

name: web-forge
